platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.intro: Switch a platform on to let people connect accounts to it. A platform that needs deployment settings cannot be used until they are set.

publishing.title: Publishing
publishing.intro: The switch for live publishing. While it is off, live posts wait and dry runs still work.
publishing.liveOn: On: posts go out to the platforms.
publishing.liveOff: Off: live posts wait until you turn it on.
publishing.native_one: {{formatted}} post is already scheduled on the platforms themselves.
publishing.native_other: {{formatted}} posts are already scheduled on the platforms themselves.
publishing.offBody: Live posts will wait until you turn it on again. Dry runs keep working.
publishing.nativeWarning_one: {{formatted}} post is already scheduled on the platform itself and will still go out.
publishing.nativeWarning_other: {{formatted}} posts are already scheduled on the platforms themselves and will still go out.

limits.title: Limits
limits.body: Set what {{name}} may keep and send. Zero means no limit.
